knowledge_items.title: DANGER: Hazard of electric shock, explosion, or arc flash
knowledge_items.description: Read and understand this manual before installing or operating the Altivar 312 drive. Installation, adjustment, repair, and maintenance must be performed by qualified personnel. Many parts of this drive, including the printed circuit boards, operate at the line voltage. DO NOT TOUCH. DO NOT short across terminals PA/+ and PC/– or across the DC bus capacitors. Before repairing the drive: disconnect all power, lock disconnects open, WAIT 15 MINUTES for the DC bus capacitors to discharge, measure the DC bus voltage between PA/+ and PC/– to ensure it is less than 42 Vdc. Install and close all covers before applying power. Failure to follow these instructions will result in death or serious injury.

knowledge_items.description: The LOCAL configuration activates the embedded RUN button and the jog dial as a potentiometer.
